payload.name: Relative Fluency and Liking
payload.fact: Liking ratings for fluent stimuli are affected by relative ease-of-processing only when that variation is manipulated WITHIN participants (comparing stimuli side by side), not when manipulated between different groups of participants.
payload.boundary: Felt fluency and certainty are affected by visual clarity regardless of whether the manipulation is within- or between-participants.
